name: Archify System Maps
description: Creates trustworthy technical system maps through an Archify-first typed-IR workflow with deterministic validation, structured repair diagnostics, verified delivery receipts, and last-known-good preservation.

routing.trigger: User needs a trustworthy architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle, or architecture-delta system map
routing.boundary: No system-map, topology, flow-visualization, or architecture-comparison intent is present
invoke_conditions: create workflow or agent tool-call map
compare architecture before and after a change
convert Mermaid or prose system description into a verified technical artifact
block_conditions: task is ordinary code generation without visualization intent
requested claim would require unsupported runtime-impact or blast-radius inference

inputs: repository evidence or bounded system description
optional existing Mermaid or structured topology
outputs: typed system-map specification or Archify IR
smallest safe next step when unresolved

tools: repository reader when source-grounded mode is requested
shell/Node.js when Archify CLI execution is requested
browser or image-capable reviewer when perceptual validation is requested
external: tt-a1i/archify (preferred rendering and validation implementation; MIT)
